items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Tanganito) they come to my father's grocery store and ask me for rice and beans... So I used to give it to them because I liked rumba... so they used to invite me.

ctx.x: What about musicians or rumberos de la calle? Were there many?
Oh yeah! Tanganito, Malanga, Andrea Baro, Roncona; you name it.
